race.comment: MY JU JU (2) showed plenty of grit on debut from the wide gate to hold a forward position with a fighting second to Pulsator over 1200m at Kembla Grange last month. Since fitted with a 740m trial placing and maps well. Hard to hold out. BENSON (6) three-year-old Hellbent colt from Ambar on debut for the John Thompson. Won his last two trials in good style and expected to go close. SACRED VOW (7) three-year-old Farnan gelding from Equal Love on debut for the Michael Freedman yard. Looked better in his latest trials and the winkers go on. Can take a hand in the finish. ANGEL HAIR (1) well in the market at debut ($4.20), with a plugging fourth over 1200m at Illawarra Grange. Key jockey change and must be kept safe.
